anatomy: T-Rex: two hind legs, two front arms SHORTER than his head; pterodactyl two legs two wings
motion_rule: T-Rex travels with his whole bulk every beat, never reaching from a standing pose; the pterodactyl works huge at the lens inside his speech beats; the tiny arms fall short
camera_moves: low angle, camera always moving, new framing every beat: push, arc, orbit, hard whip with the dragged meat, low push on the jaws, slow creep to his snout at the end
character: grumpy old T-Rex, wrinkled hide, enormous head, comically tiny front arms
cast: one T-Rex, one pterodactyl vendor huge at the lens; nobody else
props: ONE flat stone slab on the ground as the counter, one level; wooden price board, one big numeral 500, no letters; one slab of meat on the stone 4.85, dragged along it 5.6-7.1, torn away 8.4
environment: clear noon, riverside meadow, short grass; dust stays at ground level
lighting: blazing noon sun overhead, bright throughout, hard crisp shadows, rim light on his back and jaw

audio.delivery: gravelly old male voice, steady 4.5 syllables per second, never hurried
audio.pronunciation: natural native Russian stress, no accent
audio.pacing: one unbroken phrase per window, no pause between windows carrying one phrase, silence in wordless beats
audio.lip_sync: jaw works each syllable, mouth free of props, voice always from the T-Rex
audio.sfx: board clatter 0.0 and 2.5;meat slap 4.85;meat scraping 5.6-7.1;wing slap and jaw clack 8.4;stone grind and board thwack 9.1

timeline.a: he headbutts the board on the stone, it flips a body length up and slaps back down
his head snaps up off the stone, torso rocking back on his heels
he stomps a full stride at the board, whole bulk lurching in, stone shuddering under his foot
he swings head and chest across the stone, a tiny arm churning air short of the board
he overshoots, staggers sideways; pterodactyl huge at the lens snatches the board and shoves it at his cheek
he turns his whole bulk to camera, head leading; pterodactyl knocked spinning off him, board clattering onto the stone
the tail whips round and sweeps the board off the stone, it tumbles to the ground
he treads the board into the dirt, lifting his snout; pterodactyl huge at the lens slaps the slab of meat down on the stone
pterodactyl huge at the lens hauls the meat scraping down the stone; he heaves his whole bulk after it, tiny arms churning short
he hurls himself sideways along the stone, hind legs pounding, tail sweeping the grass, pterodactyl beating wings huge at the lens
he drops his whole bulk down over the stone, snout sliding along it to the meat, jaws closing on it as the last word lands
pterodactyl rips the meat from his jaws, wing-slaps his snout and bolts out of frame; his head jerks after it, jaws clacking on air
he shoves the bare stone with his snout, it grinds round; the pinned board springs from under his foot onto his nose and slides down to his eye as he rears back

must_appear: T-Rex moving his whole bulk every beat; arms shorter than his head; ONE stone slab counter; board with numeral 500; meat on the stone 4.85-8.4; pterodactyl huge at the lens
negative_prompt: cyrillic, letters, subtitles, watermark, night, dusk, dim light, dark scene, human hands, second dinosaur, extra limbs, deformed anatomy, slow motion, slow speech, static camera, T-Rex standing still, reaching without moving his feet, floating props, duplicate props, pterodactyl small in the background, accented Russian
